programme.title: Psychic Witness
programme.desc: A young woman finds her Tempe, AZ apartment burglarized and her roommate missing. Police suspect foul play, but quickly exhaust every lead. Desperate for answers, the victim's father consults psychic Gale St. John, who leads police to the girl's body - and warns that the killer will strike the roommate next. On a rural road in Louisiana, a motorist discovers the mangled body of a 16-year-old boy. Police first believe it's a hit and run - but then suspect murder. They call on psychic Rosemarie Kerr to help them find the truth - but the truth is almost too much to bear.
